article.title: The Quiet Crorepatis: The Safe Harbour Journal
article.description: The story of Suresh & Veena Kulkarni's capital-protection search in South Bengaluru — deploying ₹1.69 Cr of their ₹2.7 Cr life savings with zero loan and maximum peace of mind.
article.quote: "We didn't save for thirty years to gamble now."

learnings.text: Prioritize capital safety & OC in hand over high uncertain yields
Verify 30-year clean title chain & RWA sinking fund health
Price the sleep — buy ready assets within visible geography

quotes.text: FD is losing to inflation, Appa.
quotes.author: — Son

quotes.text: Whatever we buy, I should be able to see it from an auto.
quotes.author: — Veena

quotes.text: OC applied, sir, any day now.
quotes.author: — Builder Sales Executive

quotes.text: Strict is how you sleep, sir.
quotes.author: — Riya

chatMessages.text: Thirty-four years I have heard 'any day now' — usually from borrowers. Document, illa.
Sir, shall we make it a rule then? Not 'is it ready' — but 'what is the OC number, and where is my photocopy.'

tabs.name: Learnings
tabs.label: Learnings
tabs.title: What this journey teaches us.
tabs.description: Key takeaways for conservative buyers deploying retirement savings into ready real estate.

lessons.title: Ready-to-move ≠ OC Received.
lessons.description: 'Applied, sir, any day now' is not an OC. Demanding the photocopied OC number eliminated un-certified buildings instantly.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: An official government-issued Occupancy Certificate document stamped with a prominent red 'VERIFIED OC NUMBER' seal alongside legal property documents, detailed flat vector graphic illustration, professional beige and gold color scheme, crisp document flat-lay composition.

lessons.title: Audit RWA accounts before buying.
lessons.description: The last 3 years of society AGM minutes unmasked sinking fund health and hidden roof repair levies.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A residential society financial audit ledger page displaying green checkmarks beside sinking fund reserves and maintenance balance columns, detailed flat vector graphic illustration, clean green and white color palette, bright overhead lighting, focused document view.

lessons.title: Walk-away power sets the price.
lessons.description: Walking away twice from unreliable sellers established serious intent and secured an 8% discount on the third attempt.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A firm handshake between a buyer and a real estate representative across a table with a final discounted price contract, detailed flat vector graphic illustration, confident blue and warm orange tones, medium shot scene.

lessons.title: Price the sleep, not just the yield.
lessons.description: Leaving 20% speculative appreciation on the table was worth the absolute peace of mind of a completed OC asset.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A retired couple relaxing in easy chairs on a sunlit apartment balcony sipping filter coffee in complete contentment, warm vector graphic illustration, gentle morning sunlight and soft pastel green color palette, cozy balcony scene.
